When rollovers occur too often (e.g., > 3 per hour), strong crying is detected, or sleep talk is observed, the system pushes 'possible nightmare' or 'restless sleep' alerts to the parents. Application scenarios: child bedrooms, infant rooms. The system relays night-time monitoring to help parents understand the child's sleep quality and provide timely comfort.
